provenance.author: Farrokh Labib
provenance.method: projection monotonicity applied three times to the exact rank-5 exclusion at m = 7

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one to three cores

llm.role: wrote and ran the exact certificate, its controls and cross-checks

notes: Improves bounds/cat-m10-lower-4.json; with bounds/cat-m10-upper-9.json the cell is 6 <= chi(cat_10) <= 9. (<0|_1 (x) I)|cat_m> = 2^(-1/2)|cat_(m-1)> for m = 8, 9, 10 is checked symbolically against target_vector in the run, and <0| maps a stabilizer state to a stabilizer state or 0, so chi(cat_10) >= chi(cat_7) >= 6 by the exact exclusion described in bounds/cat-m7-lower-6.json. The compute is that of the m = 7 search.
